is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigated Anopheles gambiae sensu lato (An. gambiae s.s. and An. arabiensis) and Anopheles funestus (page 1, Abstract; page 6, Table 6).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Tested for Vgsc L1014S (kdr-East / L995S) and L1014F (kdr-West / L995F) (page 6, 'Occurrence and distribution of East (L1014S) and West (L1014F) knock-down resistance (kdr) point mutations in Anopheles gambiae in Uganda'; page 11, Table 6).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 6 (page 11) presents exact sample sizes and genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) as well as allelic frequencies for both L1014S and L1014F across four districts broken down by An. gambiae and An. arabiensis.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as adults from indoor resting collections and as larvae from breeding sites in Apac, Lira, Soroti, and Tororo Districts in Uganda (page 3, 'Mosquito collections').

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article detailing original field collections, CDC bottle bioassays, and molecular genotyping conducted in Uganda in June 2015.

sub_country_location.evidence: Collections occurred at district level in Apac, Lira, Soroti, and Tororo Districts, Uganda (page 2, 'Study sites').

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in June 2015 (page 3, 'Mosquito collections').

duplicate_risk.evidence: Work was performed under the USAID Uganda Indoor Residual Spraying Project Phase II / PMI routine surveillance, but presents original primary empirical data for this survey window.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and bioassay data are completely presented in the main text and tables (notably Table 6).

assessment.summary: This study evaluated insecticide susceptibility, PBO synergism, resistance intensity, and target-site kdr frequencies (L1014S and L1014F) in An. gambiae s.s., An. arabiensis, and An. funestus from four districts in Uganda (Apac, Lira, Soroti, Tororo) collected in June 2015. Table 6 gives exact genotype counts for L1014S and L1014F in 258 field-collected An. gambiae s.l. specimens.
